name: Electrocutioner 6000
summary: In Gnomeregan's Launch Bay, Electrocutioner 6000 guards the upper platform. The spider tank fights for Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the irradiated leper gnomes who follow him.

sections.title: Thermaplugg's Shocking Machine
sections.body: Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the irradiated leper gnomes who follow him took control of Gnomeregan's war machines after the city fell. Electrocutioner 6000 guards the upper platform of the Launch Bay, striking intruders with high-voltage current.

sections.title: The Workshop Key
sections.body: Electrocutioner 6000 guards the Workshop Key, which opens Gnomeregan's back door into its workshops. Bring down the machine, and the key offers a quicker route into the city's depths.

faq.q: Where can the Electrocutioner 6000 be found?
faq.answer: Electrocutioner 6000 stands on an elevated catwalk platform overlooking the Launch Bay in Gnomeregan.
No pilot is named in the accounts of Gnomeregan's fall. Electrocutioner 6000 fights for Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the leper gnomes who follow him.

faq.q: Why is the machine so volatile?
faq.answer: Its armored chassis channels high-voltage current and unleashes it on anyone who comes near. That power makes it a dangerous guardian of the Launch Bay.

faq.q: Why is defeating the Electrocutioner 6000 important for explorers?
faq.answer: Electrocutioner 6000 guards the Workshop Key, which unlocks Gnomeregan's back door into its deeper engineering sectors and gives explorers a faster route through the facilities.

faq.q: Is the Electrocutioner an automaton or a vehicle?
faq.answer: Electrocutioner 6000 is a mechano-tank, an armored, spider-legged war machine of gnomish make, now turned against those seeking to free Gnomeregan.

angles.text: For exiled gnomes of Ironforge, Electrocutioner 6000 is an insult to their craft: a gnomish war machine turned against its own people under Thermaplugg's rule.
Engineers marvel at the high-voltage output harnessed within Electrocutioner 6000's chassis, even as it is turned against them.
For the Alliance, breaching the Launch Bay and destroying Electrocutioner 6000 is vital to securing the Workshop Key and bypassing hazardous front corridors during efforts to free Gnomeregan.
